channel.title: Father Of The Bride
channel.desc: Romance 2022 Famed architect Billy Herrera and his wife Ingrid are heading for divorce after a troubled marriage. But when their law student daughter Sofia comes home announcing her engagement, they decide to keep their separation under wraps until after the wedding. Andy Garcia, Gloria Estefan, Diego Boneta, Adria Arjona, Isabela Merced, Gary Alazraki, Matthew Lopez.
